description: Draw the winners once the giveaway has ended. A person signed in draws at once; the same call again returns the same picks. From an assistant it changes nothing: it returns state awaiting_tap and the card, and the person taps Draw winner on the card. A key or a connection that is not an assistant is refused (APPROVAL_REQUIRED). reason is needed for a second round (when winners were disqualified and no alternate is left).

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: giveaway_draw
title: Draw the winners
